task_completion.description: Navigate to the OrientDB Studio login page and enter credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see 'demodb' in the database field and 'root' in the username field on the OrientDB Studio login page.

task_completion.description: Successfully log into the OrientDB Studio dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the OrientDB Studio main dashboard or 'Schema' tab, indicating a successful login to 'demodb'.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Countries' class within the database schema or browse view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Countries' class selected in the sidebar or as the active tab in the 'Browse' or 'Schema' view.

task_completion.description: Open the interface to create a new record/document.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a 'New' button clicked or a blank record form/editor appearing for the Countries class.

task_completion.description: Enter 'Portugal' for Name and 'European' for Type in the record fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the text 'Portugal' typed into the 'Name' field and 'European' typed into the 'Type' field.

task_completion.description: Save the record and verify it appears in the list of countries.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a 'Save' button clicked and subsequently see a row in the data table containing both 'Portugal' and 'European'.

integrity.description: The agent used the OrientDB Studio web interface rather than executing raw SQL in a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see mouse movements and clicks on the web UI elements (buttons, input fields) rather than just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply point to an existing record.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should observe the process of clicking 'New' or 'Add' and typing the specific values into empty fields.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the live OrientDB Studio instance at the specified URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar should show 'localhost:2480/studio/index.html' during the interaction.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'demodb' database is pre-seeded with several countries (e.g., Italy, Germany, France). The agent must specifically add 'Portugal' with the type 'European'. The login requires username 'root' and password 'GymAnything123!'. Success is confirmed when a new RID (Record ID) is generated for the 'Portugal' entry in the Countries class.
